plan: In a second-price sealed bid auction with values between $0-$49, the optimal strategy is to bid close to, but not exceeding, my true value. Other rational bidders will likely do the same. My value is $34, so I want to bid high enough to win if others have lower values, but not so high that I lose money. A strategic bid around $33-$34 seems optimal, as it maximizes my chance of winning while protecting potential profit.
